svg.title: Biomorphic world map — Colorset 1
svg.desc: An Equal Earth world map filled with asymmetric red, charcoal, gray, pink, and white biomorphic masses.
svg.metadata: {"schema_version":1,"pattern_id":"vectorize-biomorphic-world-map-cs1","style_reference":{"pattern_id":"vectorize-biomorphic-drift-03-cs1","relationship":"Visual vocabulary only: flat biomorphic masses, irregular drift, and Colorset 1 hierarchy; no source path geometry was copied."},"pipeline":{"mode":"organic","tile":"none","colorset":"colorset1","projection":"Equal Earth","projection_reference":"https://proj.org/en/stable/operations/projections/eqearth.html","variation_seed":732041,"composition_sha256":"48daab713377fe5526097b51fe1387f2fb344303a2c0052aa930565a719dfa55","palette_contract_sha256":"c81d32ffb0d55d44e7d3102c7470e251baf34f0bb6472fbede7753df8b9a9eb5","semantic_geometry_reuse":"Natural Earth land path is repeated once for clipping and coastline."},"source":{"source_id":"natural-earth-110m-land","title":"Natural Earth 1:110m land polygons","creator":"Natural Earth contributors; Tom Patterson and Nathaniel Vaughn Kelso","source_url":"https://github.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector","download_url":"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector/master/geojson/ne_110m_land.geojson","input_sha256":"9e0729ee253ca7d7a5c4ae9395fb1902264c5377c52e224d13dd85010e2835d9","license":"Public-Domain","license_url":"https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/","attribution":"Made with Natural Earth.","attribution_required":false,"share_alike":false,"transformation_allowed":true}}
